title: Embedding into matching indices
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a finite subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $z$ assign a sign to each index in $P$. For natural numbers $M,R$, let $(f_i)_{i<R}$ be assignments on $P$, and suppose at least $M$ of them equal $z$. Then there is an embedding of $\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$ into $\{0,\ldots,R-1\}$ whose image consists of indices with $f_i=z$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite subset of the indices $0,\ldots,n-1$
$z$ assigns a sign to each index in $P$
$f_i$ is an assignment on $P$ for each $i<R$
